label: Text with Icon
purpose: Up to 4 inline text+icon pairs (e.g. trust badges, short claims), stacked horizontally or vertically
_notes:
One block instance renders up to 4 text+icon pairs, numbered 1-4. Each pair only renders if its text_N is non-empty, so use as many pairs as you want and leave every unused text_N (and its icon_N) as an empty string "". text_N is inline_richtext — do NOT wrap in

tags. icon_N must be a Material Symbols icon name (e.g. check_circle, local_shipping, verified, star). filled_icon_N toggles solid vs outline icon style for that pair. custom_icon_N optionally replaces icon_N with an uploaded image (left empty by the AI per system prompt). direction controls whether the pairs stack horizontally or vertically. All remaining real settings (text/icon size, alignment, font, colors/gradients, width, spacing, background, border, shadow, padding, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
